priority_darshan: Quick darshan lines are available at the Lower temple counter to skip long queues.
mobility_assistance: Doli (Palanquin) Services: Doli carriers are available for hire at Lower Ahobilam to carry elderly devotees up the mountain paths to Upper temples. Lower Ahobilam Access: The Lower temple is flat and easily accessible.
comfort_facilities: Annadanam Hall: Sitting lunch/dinner options are available for seniors. First-Aid: A first-aid post is available at Lower Ahobilam near the Malola Guest House.
guidelines: Seniors should limit visits to Lower Ahobilam, or use Doli services and trek during early morning hours.
